messages.沈潜編成で、S3で付けた「邸宅の木霊」によって以後の沈潜付与のたびに確率で沈潜回: A Sinking attacker that applies Echoes of the Manor with S3, giving subsequent Sinking applications a chance to increase Count, then overpowers clashes against enemies below 0 SP.
messages.邸宅の木霊: S3「奥様の意のままに」のⅣコインの的中時、次のターンに3付与する: **Echoes of the Manor**: On Coin Ⅳ hit of S3 As Mistress Commands, inflicts 3 next turn (decreases by 1 at Turn End; refreshes rather than stacks). While applied, each time skill or Coin effects inflict Sinking Potency or Count, there is a 50% chance Sinking Count increases by 1 (this also applies to allies' infliction). Targets with SP have their Panic Type changed to Echoes of the Manor, and when they panic, 2 Echoes of the Manor spread to 2 random members of the same team.
messages.マッチ勝利で沈潜回数: S2「埃はたき」はマッチ勝利時に沈潜回数+2(低い同期化: **Sinking Count on Clash Win**: S2 Dusting adds +2 Sinking Count on Clash Win (+1 at lower Uptie), and S3 adds +3 on Clash Win. S2 has 3 Coins, inflicting 3 Sinking with Coin Ⅱ and 2 Sinking with Coin Ⅲ, stacking Potency and Count at the same time.
messages.バトルパッシブ「奥様の声が…！」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 精神力0未: **Combat passive — The Mistress's Voice...! (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: In Clashes against targets below 0 SP (below −25 at lower Uptie), +1 Clash Power and +20% damage (10% at lower Uptie). +30% damage against targets with Echoes of the Manor (15% at lower Uptie). Winning a Clash with all Coins intact restores 10 SP, or grants 3 Offense Level Up next turn if SP is already full (2 at lower Uptie), twice per turn.
messages.S3の追撃: Ⅳコインの的中時、対象に邸宅の木霊があれば沈潜威力だけ憂鬱ダメージ: **S3's follow-up**: On Coin Ⅳ hit, if the target has Echoes of the Manor, deals Gloom damage equal to its Sinking Potency (up to 30; half of Sinking Potency, up to 20, at lower Uptie).
messages.沈潜で強化: 対象の沈潜が一定以上でコイン威力+1(S1「ノック」は5以上、低い: **Sinking bonuses**: +1 Coin Power if the target's Sinking is above a threshold (S1 Knocking: 5 or more, 7 or more at lower Uptie; S2: 5 or more; S3: 7 or more). The Defense skill Insolent Fool...! inflicts 1 Sinking on a successful Evade (up to 6 times per turn, 3 at lower Uptie).
messages.S2を中心にマッチを取り、沈潜の威力と回数を積みながら、S3で邸宅の木霊を付ける: Take Clashes mainly with S2, stacking Sinking Potency and Count, and apply Echoes of the Manor with S3. While Echoes lasts, each Sinking infliction from her and her allies extends Sinking Count, so concentrate Sinking in the roughly 3 turns after applying Echoes. Sinking Count increases on Clash Win, so aim for Clashes rather than one-sided attacks. Once the enemy's SP drops below 0, the passive strengthens her Clashes and damage, and S3's Gloom damage also lands on enemies with Echoes. She only has 1 copy of S3, so note that she may not draw it early.
